description: This vertical bar chart illustrates the performance of different model configurations evaluated on the "Recall@10" metric, which serves as the chart's title. The horizontal axis displays four categorical variables, labeled from left to right as "Ours", "- critiquing", "- scoring", and "- ranking", with the text angled slightly upwards. The vertical axis represents the numerical value of the metric on a linear scale, ranging from a minimum displayed value of 0.1 to a maximum of 0.4, with tick marks and corresponding horizontal grid lines spaced at regular intervals of 0.1. The chart consists of four individual bars that are not sorted in a strict ascending or descending numerical order. The first bar, labeled "Ours", is visually emphasized in orange and represents the tallest value on the chart at approximately 0.35. The remaining three bars are uniformly colored blue. Among these, the "- critiquing" bar reaches a value of approximately 0.29, the "- scoring" bar represents the shortest value on the chart at roughly 0.17, and the "- ranking" bar indicates a value of about 0.23.
